description: This file defines a React component for a sidebar in a web application, managing categories, boards, websocket interactions, and UI state.

classes.name: Sidebar
classes.description: React component for the application's sidebar, handling categories, boards, websocket updates, and UI interactions.

methods.name: getWindowDimensions
methods.description: Returns current window width and height.

methods.name: hideSidebar
methods.description: Hides or shows the sidebar based on window size and user interaction.

methods.name: handleCategoryBoardDND

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Main handler for drag-and-drop end events, dispatching specific handlers based on item type.

methods.name: getSortedCategoryBoards
methods.description: Returns sorted boards for a given category based on category metadata.
